description: Job Description for Associate – AI Automation Engineer – Process Re-engineeringNomura Overview:Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations. At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards. Role / Principal Accountabilities: Join a newly formed AI automation team at the forefront of enterprise innovation, building cutting-edge tooling in core infrastructure. As an Associate in AI & Agentic Engineering, you will be instrumental in developing and scaling an in-house AI agent platform that transforms how the organization accesses knowledge and automates workflows. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks, while contributing to a product that will serve users across the business. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to deliver a Python-based backend and React frontend chatbot that provides intelligent knowledge search and workflow automation capabilities. This is a high-impact role where your contributions will directly shape the future of AI-driven productivity tools within the organization. The team works closely with application development teams and other platform engineering teams across group to eliminate inefficiencies and repetitive tasks. title: AI Enablement Builder
description: We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good. We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.Role OverviewNuix is building a dedicated internal AI capability to close the gap between AI promise and P&L impact. The AI Enablement Builder is a collaborativeindividual contributor who embeds directly into priority business functions, to design, build and release production-grade AI solutionsthat transform the way the function works. This is not a pure consulting or advisory role: it is a hands-on engineering position whose output is working software in production, not decks or recommendations.The successful candidate is equally fluent in AI tooling and in business process, capable of translating a vague operational problem into a structured, production-ready solution within a short rotation. They bring the engineering discipline to own an outcome from scoping through to post-launch monitoring, and the communication skills to operate credibly alongside functional leaders without requiring close technical supervision.Location:This position will be based in our Sydney office. The candidate is required to attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week but may voluntarily elect to work either remotely or from the Sydney office for the remaining 2 days of the week.Key ResponsibilitiesEmbed within assigned business functions for rotation periods of three to six months, diagnosing high-value AI opportunities and converting them into production solutions. In practice, this means conducting structured discovery with functional stakeholders, mapping current-state workflows, and scoping use cases tied directly to each function's AI enablement targets.Design, build and deploy end-to-end AI workflows, automations and agentic systems that operate in Nuix's live internal environment. Solutions may include LLM-powered document processing, RAG pipelines over internal knowledge bases, multi-step agentic workflows, reusable Nuix Neo "skill" filesor API integrations connecting Nuix's core data systems.Own the full delivery lifecycle for each use case, from initial scoping through production deployment, monitoring and iteration. This includes writing evaluation harnesses, instrumenting observability, debugging production failures and iterating based on measured outcomes - not filing tickets for others to resolve.Maintain POC discipline, rapidly validating feasibility against real internal data before committing to full build. POCs are time-boxed and exit-criteria-driven; the Builder is accountable for recommending build, pause or abandon based on evidence rather than enthusiasm.Synthesise patterns from each embedded rotation and contribute structured findings to Nuix's internal AI knowledge base and programme roadmap. Reusable components, prompt templates, integration patterns and lessons learned are documented and shared across the AI Builder cohort to accelerate subsequent rotations.Act as a credible technical peer to function leads and the broader Champion network of AI Advocates and Data Curators, translating business requirements into engineering specifications and communicating progress in plain language. This includes supporting global AI Innovation Days, presenting outcomes to functional ELT stakeholders and contributing to the mid-rotation review process, with results reported against agreed AI enablement ROI and workflow metrics.Skills, Knowledge And ExpertiseDemonstrated experience building and shipping production AI systems in an enterprise environment, with Python as the primary language. Candidates must show a track record of use cases that moved from scoping to production(not POC libraries)including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows or LLM integrations against real business data.Applied AI fluency across the core technical stack: LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agent orchestration, MCP-based tool integration, evaluation frameworks and deployment across cloud, frontier and local/open-source models. This is not a research background; the requirement is production fluency, knowing when to use which approach, how to evaluate outputs reliably and how to manage token cost and latency in live systems.Strong business process acumen, with the ability to diagnose a functional workflow problem, impose structure on an ambiguous brief and translate it into a technically tractable specification. The role sits at the intersection of engineering and light-touch consulting; candidates who can only operate with a fully scoped brief will not succeed in embedded rotation environments.A minimum of five years of software engineering or applied AI experience, with at least two years in a role requiring direct collaboration with non-technical business stakeholders. Relevant backgrounds include forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, internal tools engineering or applied AI roles in enterprise software, data intelligence, legal tech or adjacent domains.Desired ExpertiseExposure to eDiscovery, investigative analytics, legal technology or regulated-data environments. Familiarity with the data sensitivity, chain-of-custody requirements and compliance constraints typical of Nuix's core market will shorten ramp time significantly in Legal and Investigations rotations.Experience in a structured embedded or rotation-based deployment model, such as an internal centres-of-excellence, tiger team or forward-deployed engineering function. Candidates who have navigated the stakeholder dynamics, context-switching demands and knowledge-transfer obligations of time-bound embedded assignments will adapt most readily to the Nuix AI Builder model.Nuix is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t let imposter syndrome hold you back! We welcome all applications and are a flexible employer.We strive to make any required adjustments where possible to make the process fair and equitable for everyone. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please note this in your job application.Nuix is on an incredible journey of transformation, aligning our strengths with our ambitions to pursue greater opportunities. As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values.https://www.nuix.com/As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values.Nuix VisionFinding Truth in a Digital World.Nuix Mission StatementNuix creates innovative software that empowers organizations to simply and quickly find the truth from any data in a digital world. We are a passionate and talented team, delighting our customers with software that transforms data into actionable intelligence.Nuix ValuesTAKE OWNERSHIPRESILIENTUNAFRAIDTEAM NUIXHERO OUR CUSTOMERSWe believe in these principles and seek to weave them into the fabric of our daily work at Nuix.
